page.title: Import
page.lead: Bring in data from Excel, CSV or PDF. Nothing is written until you approve it: every file becomes a proposal with a per-field diff.

new.title: New import
new.file: File (PDF, Excel, CSV or ETIM xChange)
new.unsupported: This file type is not supported. Save it as .xlsx or .csv.

batch.upgrading: Updating page interpretation to the new version, without AI: page {current} of {total}…
batch.priceTargetHint: The draft version that receives the prices from the tables. Changing it does not read the pages again.
batch.setAsideTitle: Tables that did not become family proposals
batch.textlessAbsent: Page {page}: has no readable text (image). It was read with vision; its values are not checked against the text.
batch.textlessLost: Page {page}: the text exists but could not be read ({reason}). It was not sent to the model or charged — read it again.
batch.supplierHint: The supplier memory fills in the lines it knows on every new reading. It changes without a new reading and never touches pages already read.
batch.supplierLearn: Learn from the approvals of this batch
batch.supplierLearnHint: Turn it off for a trial or foreign catalog: memory still applies, the batch just does not teach it.
batch.memoryKnown: {count, plural, one {Memory knows # unmapped line.} other {Memory knows # unmapped lines.}}
batch.memoryApplyHint: Checks every open table, including lines the model mapped. No new AI reading; your own decisions stay as they are.
batch.memoryLegacy: {count, plural, one {# line was read before memory existed: “Apply memory” fills it in, without a new AI reading.} other {# lines were read before memory existed: “Apply memory” fills them in, without a new AI reading.}}
batch.memoryUndoAll: {count, plural, one {Undo # memory decision} other {Undo # memory decisions}}
batch.memoryApplied: {count, plural, =0 {Memory had nothing new to decide.} one {Memory decided # line.} other {Memory decided # lines.}}
batch.memoryUndone: {count, plural, =0 {There were no memory decisions to remove.} one {Removed # memory decision.} other {Removed # memory decisions.}}
batch.memoryLimit: Applying stopped at the batch limit of line decisions; the remaining tables were left as they were.

review.pending: {count, plural, one {# field needs a decision} other {# fields need a decision}}
review.violations: {count, plural, one {# consistency rule is not met} other {# consistency rules are not met}}
review.unverified: not confirmed by the page text
review.awaitsAttributes: Approve the attributes of the same table first. Then the new codes get their prices too.

priceLine.hint: Each code's price goes to the batch's price list as a separate proposal. It never becomes an attribute.
priceLine.source: From line {line} of the table · per {unit}

review.editedByYou: Corrected by you · the PDF said “{source}”
review.editedFromEmpty: Corrected by you · the PDF was empty
review.keepValueGroup: The source gives more than one value for “{field}” · choose the right one

remedy.title: What to do
remedy.unmappedWhy: The value was read, but the family has no attribute to receive it.

review.uncheckable: not checkable: the page has no text
review.nothingToApply: Same as live — nothing to apply
review.summaryAuto: {count, plural, one {# accepted automatically} other {# accepted automatically}}
review.summaryHuman: {count, plural, one {# accepted by you} other {# accepted by you}}
review.summaryUnmapped: {count, plural, one {# source line without a field} other {# source lines without a field}}

overlay.layer: Boxes around everything recognised on the page
overlay.reasonUnverified: the page text layer does not confirm the value
overlay.boxMore: {count, plural, one {and # more field in the same cell} other {and # more fields in the same cell}}
overlay.revealed: Shown because you selected it in the PDF — the “{view}” view hides it.

lines.title: Source lines without a field
lines.hint: The family has no attribute for them, or the model pointed to none. Map them, create a new attribute or ignore them — no new AI reading.
lines.show: Show the line in the PDF
lines.regionMissing: The line's position on the page is not available — {reason}
lines.regionLegacy: the page was read with an older version.
lines.mapUsed: This attribute already has values from another line of the table: the values will be compared and, if they differ, flagged for a decision.
lines.levelHintLeaf: Suggested “Per item code”: the line prints a different value per variant.
lines.levelHintShared: Suggested “Shared”: the line prints the same value for every variant.
lines.refusalReadingMissing: No stored table reading exists for this page. A new, paid reading is needed — only on your decision.
lines.refusalReadingVision: The page was read as an image: there is no line mapping to correct.
lines.refusalReadingClipped: The stored model answer was clipped at the storage limit.
lines.refusalTablesDrifted: The table rebuilt from the PDF no longer matches the one the model saw.
lines.refusalProposalClosed: The proposal for this table has already been applied or rejected.
lines.refusalLineUnknown: The line or the attribute was not found in the table or the family.
lines.refusalPriceTargetMissing: This batch has no price list. Choose a draft version first.
lines.refusalPriceLineTaken: This table already has a price line. Undo it first.
lines.refusalAxisOptionsInvalid: The new values do not hold: check codes and labels. Nothing was saved.
lines.refusalAxisLineMissing: No line of the table gives an axis value for every variant, even with the new values. Nothing was saved.
lines.refusalAxisLineAmbiguous: More than one line of the table gives an axis value. It is not chosen silently; nothing was saved.

decided.title: Decided lines
decided.hint: The decision on each line of the table, yours or the supplier memory’s. Undo reinterprets the table without a new AI reading.
decided.byMemory: {count, plural, one {From memory · # approval} other {From memory · # approvals}}

memory.conflict: Memory holds conflicting decisions for this label — pick one:

axis.title: New axis values
axis.hint: The variants print codes the axis does not recognise.
axis.lead: The values are added to the family axis and the code line is bound to it. Each variant shows what will be read with the new values; saving opens when all of them are read.
axis.notAxis: The axis of this proposal is not an option list of the family. Its values are changed from the attributes tab.
axis.nothingNew: All values already exist; only the code line will be bound to the axis.
axis.label: Label
axis.prefixOf: Read as the existing value “{option}” only because the code starts that way. If it is a different device with the same number, do not save.
axis.corrected: You corrected the code to “{corrected}”: after saving, correct this variant’s axis value too.
axis.issueCodeInvalid: The code needs lowercase Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
axis.issueCodeTaken: The code already exists with another label.

issues.misaligned: This value does not line up with the rest of the variant's column in the PDF. Check whether it belongs to a neighbouring column.
issues.sharedDisagrees: The source rows give different values for an attribute shared by the whole model.
issues.levelUnsupported: This attribute lives on a sub-model: import does not write an intermediate level yet.
issues.modelCodeMissing: The source gives no model code. Fill it in to apply this proposal.
issues.skuUnknown: No live item has the code “{code}”.
issues.priceIncomplete: A new price line needs a price and a unit.
issues.priceAmountPrecision: This price has more decimals than the currency holds. Enter it per 10, 100 or 1000 units so it is not rounded.
issues.priceUnitUnknown: This unit is not known. Enter a catalog unit, for example pcs, m or kg.
issues.measurementUnitMissing: No unit was read for this value. Enter it with the unit as in the PDF, for example “1000 W”.
issues.unitUnconfirmed: The unit “{unit}” is not confirmed by the page text. Check it in the PDF.
issues.attributeRepeated: The source also gives another value for this attribute: {others}. Choose the correct one.
issues.tableStructureDisputed: The PDF tags and the table lines point to different cells. Check this value in the PDF.
issues.noValueReplacesValue: The source says “not applicable”, but the attribute has a value in the catalog. Approving will remove it; you decide.
issues.unknownKeepsValue: The source says “unknown”, but the catalog knows the value. The value stays.
issues.noValueReasonUnreadable: This text is not a reason for a missing value. Write notApplicable or unknown.
issues.identityKeysDisagree: The item code and the GTIN of this row point to different catalogue items. Correct the source.
issues.awaitsAttributes: The code “{code}” is created by the attributes proposal of this table. Its price waits for that approval.
issues.editSourceChanged: You corrected this to “{edited}” when the PDF said “{was}”. The PDF now says “{now}”: keep your correction or accept the PDF value.

assetFetch.title: Media from links
assetFetch.progress: {total, plural, one {{ready} of # media file ready} other {{ready} of # media files ready}}
assetFetch.fetching: {count, plural, one {Downloading # media file} other {Downloading # media files}}
assetFetch.failedCount: {count, plural, one {# media file was not downloaded} other {# media files were not downloaded}}

failure.notFound: The supplier’s link no longer points to a file (404). Ask the supplier for a new link.
failure.httpError: The supplier’s server did not return the file. Try again later.
failure.timeout: The supplier’s server took too long to respond. Try again.
failure.tooLarge: The file exceeds the size limit for this kind of media.
failure.notPublic: The address points to a private or internal network and is not downloaded.
failure.dnsFailed: The supplier’s server name could not be found.
failure.tooManyRedirects: The link redirects too many times to reach a file.
failure.invalidUri: The address is not a valid public http or https link.
failure.notAFile: The link opens a web page, not a file (for example a sign-in page or an error page).
failure.unknownContent: The downloaded content is not a file type the catalogue accepts.
failure.kindMismatch: The file is valid, but not of a kind this media role accepts.
failure.typeConflict: The link’s extension or declared type does not match the file’s actual content.
failure.contentUnavailable: The file was downloaded but could not be kept: the record of the same content is in an unexpected state. Retry; if it happens again, contact support.

memory.title: Supplier label memory
memory.lead: What approvals have taught: line label → decision, with how many approvals backed it. Forget a label and memory asks again.
memory.empty: This supplier has no memory yet. It learns whenever a table is approved.
memory.label: Label
memory.inactive: Inactive: the attribute is no longer in the library
memory.clearConfirm: Every label of this supplier will be forgotten. Decisions in batches stay; they just will not apply to new readings.
memory.cleared: {count, plural, =0 {There was nothing to forget.} one {Forgot # label.} other {Forgot # labels.}}
